other_conditions: Engaged in any building or other construction work
Registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Active membership of the Board required
Child must achieve the highest marks in the SSLC examination in their district
benefits_summary: Cash prizes of ₹1000, ₹750 and ₹500 are awarded annually to the top three male and top three female SSLC scorers in each district.
